'''TV Tokyo''' (Japanese: '''株式会社テレビ東京''', ''{{wp|Kabushiki gaisha}} Terebi Tōkyō'') is a TV station based in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}.  TV Tokyo is located in the {{wp|Minato, Tokyo|Minato}} destrict of Tokyo. Its current president is Shimada Masayuki. As of 2010, the station is a wholly-owned subsidiary of {{wp|TV Tokyo Holdings}}.

==History==
TV Tokyo was launched on April 12, 1964 as '''Science Television Tokyo Channel 12''' (Japanese: 科学テレビ東京12チャンネルテレビ, ''Kagaku Terebi Tōkyō Jūni-channeru Terebi'') and was originally owned by the Science and Technology Promotion Foundation. In 1968, ownership of the channel moved to a separate company known as '''Tokyo Channel 12 Production, Ltd.''' (Japanese: 株式会社東京12チャンネルプロダクション, ''Kabushiki gaisha Tōkyō 12 Channeru Purodakushon''). In 1973, the station changed its name to '''Tokyo Channel 12, Ltd.''' (Japanese: 株式会社東京12チャンネル, ''Kabushiki gaisha Terebi Tōkyō Jūni-channeru''). Another name change in 1981 gave the station its current name, '''Television Tokyo Channel 12, Ltd.''' (Japanese: 株式会社テレビ東京, ''Kabushiki gaisha Terebi Tōkyō''). In 2004, following its IPO, the company changed its English name to '''TV Tokyo Corporation'''. In 2010, TV Tokyo, alongside TV Tokyo Broadband and BS Japan merged to form a holding company known as TV Tokyo Holdings. TV Tokyo became a wholly-owned subsidiary of the company, retaining its operational structure instead of a major restructuring of TV Tokyo.

==Information==
TV Tokyo is currently the smallest of the major Tokyo TV networks, and is known for its specialization in anime. In 2014, TV Tokyo celebrated its 50th anniversary. TV Tokyo aired episodes of {{aniseries|PTS}} from its beginning in 1997, until its conclusion in 2023. New episodes of the current Pokémon [[series]], {{aniseries|HZ}}, are aired most Fridays at 6:55 PM {{wp|Japan Standard Time|JST}} (9:55 AM {{wp|UTC}}/4:55 AM {{wp|Eastern Standard Time|EST}}).

Starting with the first episode of {{aniseries|BW}}, the broadcast of the {{pkmn|animated series}} on TV Tokyo uses [[data broadcasting]].
